This is my main plot, so I must look after it well. I will try to get one bag of NPK fertilizer from the agro-dealer to give the sorghum strength, and I will also spread cow dung that I have kept from my animals because the soil here is too sandy. I will plant with my own seed saved from last season since the improved seed is costly and sometimes hard to trust. My family will do most of the work, but when the weeds come strong and at harvest time, I will hire some young men from the village for extra hands.
